_comment: 'rule' is the stable, hand-verified cycle. It is NOT auto-rebased by the scraper:
a one-off bank-holiday shift must never permanently rotate the whole cycle.
Verified against the council's published 12-month calendar (Jul 2026 - Jun 2027):
all 26 collections on the second half matched the rule exactly.
The council also states the cadence in words on the property page:
black = 'Every Friday fortnightly', blue and brown = 'Every 4th Friday'.
